> [!TIP]
> Hi there! Thank you for suggesting a feature.
>
> Keep answers concise (2-5 bullet points or sentences per section). If your feature is larger than that, please separate it into smaller, linked issues. [Contact the developers](https://github.com/merlinseela/i40-saftch/discussions) if you need help splitting up a "god-issue".
>
> **Title Format:** Please ensure your issue title follows the FDD syntax above (e.g., *"Route the status logs of the Hardware-Daemon"*).
>
> *(You can delete this tip box once you have read it.)*

### 1. Goal & Success Metric
**Business/Scientific Value**
> * What is the specific problem being solved or the goal being achieved?
> * Why is this feature necessary for the framework?

[Your answer here]

**Success Measurement**
> * How will success be verified? 
> * What specific technical metric, log output, or pipeline result proves this feature works?

[Your answer here]

### 2. Proposed Solution (Design by Feature)
**Implementation Path**
> * What is the most likely solution, tool, or architectural approach required to build this feature?
> * Which existing components will need to be modified?
> * Which components will be created?

[Your answer here]

### 3. Constraints & Tech-Stack
**Limitations, Environment & Timing**
> * Is this feature blocked by another issue or dependent on a specific milestone? 
> * Does it require a specific hardware target or software version?
> * *(If none, simply write "None")*

[Your answer here]

### 4. Appendix & Checklist
Please supply the following if applicable to help speed up development:
- [ ] Architecture diagrams, workflow sketches or screenshots
- [ ] Links to relevant documentation or standards
- [ ] Example manifests or payload structures (e.g. `.json`, `.yaml`)
- [ ] Draft test-cases or boilerplate code (e.g. `.py`, `.vhdl`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Final Check:** *Did you answer all sections? If a section doesn't apply, please write "N/A" and provide one reason why. (You can Delete this Note after reading it.)*
